quiz_title: Complete Quiz Example - All Question Types
quiz_description: This is a comprehensive example showing all supported question types in the MSARLink quiz system

questions.question_text: What is the capital of Saudi Arabia?
questions.explanation: Riyadh is the capital and largest city of Saudi Arabia, located in the center of the Arabian Peninsula.

questions.question_text: Select all programming languages from the following options:
questions.explanation: Python, JavaScript, and Java are programming languages. HTML and XML are markup languages, while CSS is a styling language.
The Earth is approximately spherical in shape, not flat. This has been scientifically proven through various methods.

questions.question_text: Which of the following are web development frameworks?
questions.explanation: React, Angular, Vue.js are JavaScript frameworks, and Bootstrap is a CSS framework. Photoshop and Microsoft Word are not web development tools.
HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language, which is the standard markup language for creating web pages.

questions.question_text: JavaScript is the same as Java programming language.
questions.explanation: JavaScript and Java are completely different programming languages with different syntax, use cases, and origins.

questions.question_text: Which HTTP methods are commonly used in RESTful APIs?
questions.explanation: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH are the most commonly used HTTP methods in RESTful APIs. CONNECT and TRACE are less commonly used.

questions.question_text: What is the correct way to declare a variable in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: In JavaScript, variables can be declared using 'var', 'let', or 'const' keywords. 'var myVariable;' is the traditional way to declare a variable.

questions.question_text: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets.
questions.explanation: CSS indeed stands for Cascading Style Sheets, which is used to describe the presentation of HTML documents.

questions.question_text: Which of the following are valid CSS selectors?
questions.explanation: .class-name (class selector), #id-name (ID selector), element-name (element selector), * (universal selector), and ::before (pseudo-element) are all valid CSS selectors. @media is a CSS rule, not a selector.
